Suddenly, a woman wearing a black jacket and jeans runs into the frame from the left and hugs him tightly from behind. They drive slowly across the tiled patio. (4) As they ride, the man and woman look toward the camera, smiling and making various playful hand gestures. The man points at the lens while the woman holds onto the handlebars. (5) They continue riding while performing synchronized playful movements, such as saluting, forming a heart shape with their hands over their heads, and pointing together toward the camera.
